newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali faction detains Kenyan ship and 34 crew.
newsitem.headline: Somali faction detains Kenyan ship and 34 crew.

text.p: A Somali faction using speedboats have detained a Kenyan-registered ship and its crew accused of illegally fishing in Somali waters, local officials said on Tuesday.
Abdi Said Ali, chairman of Jarriban district in central Somalia, said by radio the Italian-owned Bahari Hindi was intercepted by militiamen aboard speedboats on Sunday and forced to dock.

Ali told journalists in Mogadishu by radio from Jarriban the 34 crew included Italians, Kenyans, Poles, Senegalese, Romanians and four Somalis and would be brought before a court of the Somali Salvation Democratic Front (SSDF) in northeast Somalia.
Ali said the crew would be accused of illegally fishing in Somali waters and the ship would also be searched in case it was carrying any toxic materials that were to be dumped off Somalia.
Ali said the crew was being well treated.
Somalia has had no central government since the overthrow of late dictator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991 and is divided in fiefdoms ruled by a series of factions.
